title: RusCode: Russian Cultural Code Benchmark for Text-to-Image Generation

bias_targets.methodology: Human evaluation via side-by-side comparison of generated images from multiple text-to-image models (Stable Diffusion 3, DALL-E 3, Kandinsky 3.1, YandexART 2) using the RusCode benchmark, which contains 1250 prompts representing Russian cultural concepts across 19 categories. The study also tested automated evaluation using CLIP Score.
